prompt: I'm planning a 3-day trip to Macau with my family. We want to see the historic sites, eat local food, and maybe spend one evening at a casino resort. What districts should we stay in and how should we get around?
expected: Load visitor-itineraries.md, visitor-lodging.md, neighborhoods-choosing.md, food-overview.md, transport.md. Recommend historic peninsula + Taipa for heritage/food, Cotai for casino evening. Suggest walking + bus + hotel shuttles. Provide district-specific guidance.
actual: Agent should: (1) Load references/visitor-itineraries.md for 3-day routes, (2) Load references/visitor-lodging.md for family-friendly stays, (3) Load references/neighborhoods-choosing.md to match 'heritage + food + casino' profile → recommend historic peninsula + Taipa Village for days 1-2, Cotai for casino evening, (4) Load references/transport.md for getting around → suggest bus MOP 6 + hotel shuttles (free) + walking in historic core, (5) Load references/food-overview.md + food-local.md for local food recommendations. prompt: I got a job offer in Macau. The salary is MOP 22,000/month. Can I afford to live there? What should I budget for rent and daily expenses? I'm single and prefer modern apartments.
expected: Load cost.md, neighborhoods-choosing.md. Compare salary to median (MOP 18,000). Estimate rent for 1BR modern Taipa (MOP 18,000-28,000) or older peninsula (MOP 10,000-18,000). Provide realistic budget breakdown. Note that MOP 22k is above median but rent will consume 50-80% if choosing modern Taipa.
actual: Agent should: (1) Load references/cost.md for 2026 rental data, (2) Compare MOP 22,000 to median earnings MOP 18,000 (DSEC Q2/2026) → above median by 22%, (3) For 'modern apartments' preference → Taipa modern complex MOP 18,000-28,000/month, (4) Calculate rent-to-income ratio: 82%-127% if choosing Taipa modern → flag as tight budget, (5) Suggest older peninsula stock MOP 10,000-18,000 as more sustainable option (45%-82% of income), (6) Provide daily expense estimates: casual meals MOP 60-120, bus MOP 6, utilities MOP 600-1,200, groceries MOP 2,500-4,000. Should mention 2-3 months security deposit upfront.

prompt: I'm a US citizen. Can I just fly into Macau and stay for a month? Do I need a visa? Also, can I work remotely from there on a tourist stay?
expected: Load visas.md. Confirm US citizens get 30 days visa-free (not 1 month). Explain that tourist stay does not authorize work (even remote). Point to official gov.mo source. Suggest checking if longer stay or work permit is needed.
actual: Agent should: (1) Load references/visas.md for entry requirements, (2) Confirm US citizens get 30 days visa-free (not 'a month' — exact duration matters), (3) Clarify that 30 days ≠ 1 month and passport must be valid 90+ days beyond stay, (4) Explain tourist stay does NOT authorize work (remote or local) — must check work permit requirements, (5) Point to official source: https://www.gov.mo/en/services/ps-1474/ps-1474b/, (6) Suggest contacting Macau Immigration or checking if longer stay/work permit is needed for remote work scenario. Should NOT claim certainty without loading visas.md.
